literal: Without an official dispatch, they may not leave the Imperial City without authorization.
idiomatic: Without an official dispatch, they may not leave the Imperial City without authorization.

literal: If any outside official is found in contact with them, on discovery both shall be sentenced to death together.
idiomatic: If any outside official is found in contact with them, on discovery both shall be sentenced to death together.

literal: Intercalary sixth month, day bingyin: made Cheng Kegong Grand Secretary of the Secretariat Academy, Zhang Duan Grand Secretary of the Guoshi Academy, and Liu Zhengzong Grand Secretary of the Hongwen Academy.
idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, on bingyin, Cheng Kegong was made Grand Secretary of the Secretariat Academy, Zhang Duan Grand Secretary of the Guoshi Academy, and Liu Zhengzong Grand Secretary of the Hongwen Academy.

literal: Day yihai: made Jin Zhijun Minister of Personnel.
idiomatic: On yihai Jin Zhijun was appointed Minister of Personnel.

literal: Day gengchen, an edict said: 「Examining the Great Plan, respectful conduct is the sign of timely rain; the correspondence of Heaven and man is in principle never in error.
idiomatic: On gengchen an edict said: 「Examining the Great Plan, respectful conduct is the sign of timely rain; the correspondence of Heaven and man is in principle never in error.

literal: I attend to Heaven from dawn to dusk, hoping to meet Heaven's favor.
idiomatic: I attend to Heaven from dawn to dusk, hoping to meet Heaven's favor.

literal: Yet lately the capital has had unbroken rain for a month, water standing in channels, ruining the people's houses; the poorest are displaced and in hard straits for food — all this my lack of virtue has brought about.
idiomatic: Yet lately the capital has had unbroken rain for a month, water standing in channels, ruining the people's houses; the poorest are displaced and in hard straits for food — all this my lack of virtue has brought about.

literal: Now I devote myself wholly to self-examination and revere Heaven's warning.
idiomatic: Now I devote myself wholly to self-examination and revere Heaven's warning.

literal: Ministers great and small should warn one another and restrain themselves.
idiomatic: Ministers great and small should warn one another and restrain themselves.

literal: Seventh month, day jiawu, first of the month: on the Empress Dowager's instruction, eight hundred thousand taels of savings silver were issued to relieve soldiers and civilians from flood disaster.
idiomatic: On jiawu, the first day of the seventh month, on the Empress Dowager's instruction eight hundred thousand taels of savings silver were issued to relieve soldiers and civilians stricken by flood.

literal: Day xinchou: made Yi Yonggui Governor of Southern Gan.
idiomatic: On xinchou Yi Yonggui was appointed Governor of Southern Gan.

literal: Day gengxu: the Emperor's second son Fuquan was born.
idiomatic: On gengxu the Emperor's second son Fuquan was born.

literal: Day xinyou: made Prince An Yuele General Who Displays Might and ordered him to lead troops to garrison Guihua City.
idiomatic: On xinyou Prince An Yuele was made General Who Displays Might and ordered to lead troops to garrison Guihua City.

literal: Eighth month, day renwu: the Taizong's fourteenth daughter, the Heshuo Princess, was given in marriage to Wu Yingxiong, son of Pingxi Prince Wu Sangui.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renwu, the Taizong's fourteenth daughter, the Heshuo Princess, was given in marriage to Wu Yingxiong, son of Pingxi Prince Wu Sangui.

literal: Shang Kexi took Huazhou and Wuchuan.
idiomatic: Shang Kexi took Huazhou and Wuchuan.

literal: Day jiashen: fixed the grades of military offices.
idiomatic: On jiashen the grades of military offices were fixed.

literal: Day bingxu: made Lei Xing Governor of Henan.
idiomatic: On bingxu Lei Xing was appointed Governor of Henan.

literal: Day jichou: deposed the Empress as Consort Jing.
idiomatic: On jichou the Empress was deposed as Consort Jing.

literal: Day xinmao: Li Dingguo attacked Pingle; Circuit Intendant Zhou Yongxu, Prefect Yin Mingting, and Magistrates Tu Qipeng and Hua Zhong died in the fighting.
idiomatic: On xinmao Li Dingguo attacked Pingle; Circuit Intendant Zhou Yongxu, Prefect Yin Mingting, and Magistrates Tu Qipeng and Hua Zhong died in the fighting.

literal: Ninth month, day renzi: restored the Ministry of Justice's thrice-reviewed capital cases.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi, the Ministry of Justice's thrice-reviewed capital cases were restored.

literal: Day bingchen: Geng Jimao and Kakamu took Chaozhou.
idiomatic: On bingchen Geng Jimao and Kakamu took Chaozhou.

literal: Day dingsi: Meng Qiaofang attacked the former Ming Prince of Yichuan Zhu Jingsu at Ziyang and pacified him.
idiomatic: On dingsi Meng Qiaofang attacked the former Ming Prince of Yichuan Zhu Jingsu at Ziyang and pacified him.

literal: Tenth month, day guihai, first of the month: ordered Tian Xiong to move his headquarters to Dinghai.
idiomatic: On guihai, the first day of the tenth month, Tian Xiong was ordered to move his headquarters to Dinghai.

literal: Day yichou: Ma Guanghui and others attacked the rebel general Hai Shixing at Yongcheng; Shixing was executed.
idiomatic: On yichou Ma Guanghui and others attacked the rebel general Hai Shixing at Yongcheng; Shixing was executed.

literal: Day bingyin: sent Jixihai to campaign against Shandong bandits.
idiomatic: On bingyin Jixihai was sent to campaign against Shandong bandits.

literal: Day yiyou: established gruel kitchens to relieve the hungry in the capital.
idiomatic: On yiyou gruel kitchens were established to relieve the hungry in the capital.

literal: Remitted disaster levies for seven prefectures and counties including Tong and Miyun.
idiomatic: Disaster levies were remitted for seven prefectures and counties including Tong and Miyun.

literal: Day wuzi: ordered Grand Secretaries and academicians to take turns on duty inside the Gate of Supreme Harmony.
idiomatic: On wuzi Grand Secretaries and academicians were ordered to take turns on duty inside the Gate of Supreme Harmony.

literal: Eleventh month, day jiawu: sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiawu, the Emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound.

literal: Day wuxu: Zheng Chenggong declined the enfeoffment; a gracious edict answered him.
idiomatic: On wuxu Zheng Chenggong declined the enfeoffment; a gracious edict answered him.

literal: Day wushen: made Kang Deshi Governor of Henan.
idiomatic: On wushen Kang Deshi was appointed Governor of Henan.

literal: Day jiyou: government troops campaigned against the rebel Muslims of Xining and pacified them.
idiomatic: On jiyou government troops campaigned against the rebel Muslims of Xining and pacified them.

literal: Day yimao: Zhu Mala and Jin Zhijun were dismissed.
idiomatic: On yimao Zhu Mala and Jin Zhijun were dismissed.

literal: Day bingchen: remitted disaster levies for Jiangnan.
idiomatic: On bingchen disaster levies for Jiangnan were remitted.

literal: Day wuwu: Liu Qingtai suppressed the bandits of Jiuxian Mountain and pacified them.
idiomatic: On wuwu Liu Qingtai suppressed the bandits of Jiuxian Mountain and pacified them.

literal: Day jiwei: remitted disaster levies for fifty-four prefectures and counties in Jiangxi.
idiomatic: On jiwei disaster levies were remitted for fifty-four prefectures and counties in Jiangxi.

literal: Twelfth month, day bingyin: made Chen Tai Great General Who Pacifies the South and Subdues Bandits, with Lanbai to guard Hunan.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingyin, Chen Tai was made Great General Who Pacifies the South and Subdues Bandits, with Lanbai to guard Hunan.

literal: Day dingmao: made Lü Gong Grand Secretary of the Hongwen Academy, Bobo'erdai a Deliberative Minister, and Feng Shengzhao Governor of Pianyuan.
idiomatic: On dingmao Lü Gong was made Grand Secretary of the Hongwen Academy, Bobo'erdai a Deliberative Minister, and Feng Shengzhao Governor of Pianyuan.

literal: Day xinwei: visited the Southern Park.
idiomatic: On xinwei the Emperor visited the Southern Park.

literal: Day jiaxu: remitted nine years of disaster levies for eight counties in Jinhua.
idiomatic: On jiaxu nine years of disaster levies were remitted for eight counties in Jinhua.

literal: Day guimao: established supervisory arrest officers in the Ministry of War.
idiomatic: On guimao supervisory arrest officers were established in the Ministry of War.

literal: Made Luo Bi a Deliberative Minister.
idiomatic: Luo Bi was made a Deliberative Minister.

literal: Day jiashen: remitted disaster levies of the ninth and tenth years for Kaifeng, Zhangde, Weihui, Huaiqing, and Runing.
idiomatic: On jiashen disaster levies of the ninth and tenth years were remitted for Kaifeng, Zhangde, Weihui, Huaiqing, and Runing.

literal: Day bingxu: Zheng Chenggong attacked Wusong; government troops drove him off.
idiomatic: On bingxu Zheng Chenggong attacked Wusong; government troops drove him off.

literal: Day dinghai: returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On dinghai the Emperor returned to the palace.

literal: That night there was an earthquake with a sound.
idiomatic: That night there was an earthquake with a sound.

literal: This year Korea, Ryukyu, Sonoi E'erdeni and Erdeni Hatan Batulu of the Tüsheet Khan division of the Khalkha, Gushri Khan and Gushri Khan's taiji Nomuchi of the Oirat, Badaktu of the Solon, Yikuda of Fulacun, Umete and Erduke of Heilongjiang, and the Dalai Lama of Tibet all came to tribute.
idiomatic: This year Korea, Ryukyu, Sonoi E'erdeni and Erdeni Hatan Batulu of the Tüsheet Khan division of the Khalkha, Gushri Khan and Gushri Khan's taiji Nomuchi of the Oirat, Badaktu of the Solon, Yikuda of Fulacun, Umete and Erduke of Heilongjiang, and the Dalai Lama of Tibet all came to tribute.

literal: Korea came again.
idiomatic: Korea came again.

literal: Eleventh year, spring, first month, day xinchou: abolished weaving officials.
idiomatic: In the eleventh year, in the first month of spring, on xinchou, weaving officials were abolished.

literal: Day wushen: remitted last year's disaster levies for Jiangning, Anhui, Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Luzhou, Fengyang, Huai'an, Xuzhou, and Chuzhou.
idiomatic: On wushen last year's disaster levies were remitted for Jiangning, Anhui, Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Luzhou, Fengyang, Huai'an, Xuzhou, and Chuzhou.

literal: Day jiyou: made Yuan Kuoyu Governor of Pianyuan and Hu Quancai Pacification Commissioner of Yunyang.
idiomatic: On jiyou Yuan Kuoyu was appointed Governor of Pianyuan and Hu Quancai Pacification Commissioner of Yunyang.

literal: Day gengxu: the Yuedong bandits of Renhua, Guangdong, were pacified.
idiomatic: On gengxu the Yuedong bandits of Renhua, Guangdong, were pacified.

literal: Day guichou: Zheng Chenggong attacked Chongming, Jingjiang, and Taixing; government troops drove him off.
idiomatic: On guichou Zheng Chenggong attacked Chongming, Jingjiang, and Taixing; government troops drove him off.

literal: Day jiayin: made Jin Li Governor-General of the Three Borders of Shaanxi and Sichuan.
idiomatic: On jiayin Jin Li was appointed Governor-General of the Three Borders of Shaanxi and Sichuan.

literal: Day yimao: Zheng Chenggong attacked Jinshan.
idiomatic: On yimao Zheng Chenggong attacked Jinshan.

literal: Day dingsi: remitted last year's disaster levies for Shunde, Guangping, Daming, Tianjin, and Jizhou.
idiomatic: On dingsi last year's disaster levies were remitted for Shunde, Guangping, Daming, Tianjin, and Jizhou.

literal: Day xinyou: government troops attacked bandits at Taoyuan and executed the false general Li Yangchun and others.
idiomatic: On xinyou government troops attacked bandits at Taoyuan and executed the false general Li Yangchun and others.

literal: Second month, day guihai: worshipped the sun at the eastern suburb.
idiomatic: In the second month, on guihai, the Emperor worshipped the sun at the eastern suburb.

literal: Day bingyin, an edict said: 「Censors are the organs of hearing and sight; I have repeatedly sought frank speech and looked for it with utmost urgency.
idiomatic: On bingyin an edict said: 「Censors are the organs of hearing and sight; I have repeatedly sought frank speech and looked for it with utmost urgency.

literal: Yet whenever I read memorials, few are those who serve the state with a true heart; many compare factions and show private favor — this I deeply disapprove.
idiomatic: Yet whenever I read memorials, few are those who serve the state with a true heart; many compare factions and show private favor — this I deeply disapprove.

literal: Let them cleanse their hearts and renew their politics.
idiomatic: Let them cleanse their hearts and renew their politics.

literal: 」Made Jin Zhijun Grand Secretary of the Guoshi Academy.
idiomatic: 」Jin Zhijun was made Grand Secretary of the Guoshi Academy.

literal: Day gengwu: evaluated governors-general and governors of the provinces; dismissals and promotions varied.
idiomatic: On gengwu governors-general and governors of the provinces were evaluated; dismissals and promotions varied.

literal: Day bingzi: for the first time plowed the sacred field.
idiomatic: On bingzi the Emperor for the first time plowed the sacred field.

literal: Day wuyin: remitted shortfall corvée levies for Jiangxi.
idiomatic: On wuyin shortfall corvée levies for Jiangxi were remitted.

literal: Day xinsi: ordered Shang Kexi to guard Guangdong exclusively and Geng Jimao to move his headquarters to Guilin.
idiomatic: On xinsi Shang Kexi was ordered to guard Guangdong exclusively and Geng Jimao to move his headquarters to Guilin.

literal: Day renwu: made Ma Mingpei Governor-General of Xuan, Da, and Shanxi; Geng Kun Governor of Shandong; Chen Yingtai Governor of Shanxi; Lin Tianqing Governor of Huguang; and Huang Tu'an Governor of Ningxia.
idiomatic: On renwu Ma Mingpei was made Governor-General of Xuan, Da, and Shanxi; Geng Kun Governor of Shandong; Chen Yingtai Governor of Shanxi; Lin Tianqing Governor of Huguang; and Huang Tu'an Governor of Ningxia.

literal: Day guimao: government troops recovered Pingyuan County.
idiomatic: On guimao government troops recovered Pingyuan County.

literal: Day jiashen, an edict said: 「In recent years warfare has not ceased; supplies are urgently demanded; flood and drought add to the burden; the common people have a hard time finding food; officials have failed to comfort and guide them, and the displaced crowd the roads.
idiomatic: On jiashen an edict said: 「In recent years warfare has not ceased; supplies are urgently demanded; flood and drought add to the burden; the common people have a hard time finding food; officials have failed to comfort and guide them, and the displaced crowd the roads.

literal: My heart is deeply moved; I have no peace even to lie down.
idiomatic: My heart is deeply moved; I have no peace even to lie down.

literal: I have immediately checked the treasury stores and urgently planned relief.
idiomatic: I have immediately checked the treasury stores and urgently planned relief.

literal: 」Day jichou: remitted disaster levies of the tenth year for prefectures, counties, and guards of Henan.
idiomatic: 」On jichou disaster levies of the tenth year were remitted for prefectures, counties, and guards of Henan.

literal: Day gengyin: made Li Yinzu Governor-General of Zhili, Shandong, and Henan.
idiomatic: On gengyin Li Yinzu was appointed Governor-General of Zhili, Shandong, and Henan.

literal: Third month, day renchen: government troops attacked the bandits of Guidong and captured their leader Lai Long.
idiomatic: In the third month, on renchen, government troops attacked the bandits of Guidong and captured their leader Lai Long.

literal: Day wuxu: remitted disaster levies of the tenth year for Xiangyang, Huangzhou, Changde, Yuezhou, Yongzhou, Jingzhou, and De'an in Huguang and the three guards of Chen, Chang, and Xiang; and for Jinan and Dongchang in Shandong.
idiomatic: On wuxu disaster levies of the tenth year were remitted for Xiangyang, Huangzhou, Changde, Yuezhou, Yongzhou, Jingzhou, and De'an in Huguang and the three guards of Chen, Chang, and Xiang; and for Jinan and Dongchang in Shandong.

literal: Day xinchou: Ning Wanwo impeached Chen Mingxia for crime; the case was verified and he was executed.
idiomatic: On xinchou Ning Wanwo impeached Chen Mingxia for crime; the case was verified and he was executed.

literal: Day yisi: made Wang Yongji Left Censor-in-Chief.
idiomatic: On yisi Wang Yongji was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

literal: Day wushen: the Emperor's third son Xuanye was born — this was the Shengzu (Kangxi Emperor).
idiomatic: On wushen the Emperor's third son Xuanye was born — this was the Shengzu (Kangxi Emperor).

literal: Made Jiang Hede Grand Secretary of the Guoshi Academy.
idiomatic: Jiang Hede was made Grand Secretary of the Guoshi Academy.

literal: Day yimao: Doroi Prince Huizhe E'ergen, Doroi Prince Xuanxian Jiekan, and Doroi Prince Tongda Yarhaqi were given joint sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
idiomatic: On yimao Doroi Prince Huizhe E'ergen, Doroi Prince Xuanxian Jiekan, and Doroi Prince Tongda Yarhaqi were given joint sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

literal: Made Meng Mingfu Minister of War.
idiomatic: Meng Mingfu was appointed Minister of War.

literal: Summer, fourth month, day renxu: the bandit leader Cao Zhipan attacked Raozhou; government troops defeated him and Zhipan surrendered.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renxu, the bandit leader Cao Zhipan attacked Raozhou; government troops defeated him and Zhipan surrendered.

literal: Day gengwu: the Sichuan bandit Wei Yong attacked Shunqing; government troops defeated him.
idiomatic: On gengwu the Sichuan bandit Wei Yong attacked Shunqing; government troops defeated him.

literal: Day renshen: earthquake.
idiomatic: On renshen there was an earthquake.

literal: Government troops attacked the former Ming generals Zhang Mingzhen and others at Chongming and defeated them.
idiomatic: Government troops attacked the former Ming generals Zhang Mingzhen and others at Chongming and defeated them.

literal: Day guiyou: remitted one-third of last year's disaster levies for Luonan.
idiomatic: On guiyou one-third of last year's disaster levies for Luonan were remitted.

literal: Day jimao: visited the Southern Park and bestowed gold on farmers passed along the way.
idiomatic: On jimao the Emperor visited the Southern Park and bestowed gold on farmers passed along the way.

literal: Day yiyou: remitted last year's disaster levies for four counties including Baokang, ravaged by bandits.
idiomatic: On yiyou last year's disaster levies were remitted for four counties including Baokang, ravaged by bandits.

literal: Day dinghai: made Wang Yongji Grand Secretary of the Secretariat Academy and Qin Shizhen Governor of Zhejiang.
idiomatic: On dinghai Wang Yongji was made Grand Secretary of the Secretariat Academy and Qin Shizhen Governor of Zhejiang.

literal: Day wuzi: the Jiangnan bandits Xu Kejin, Zhu Yuan, and others surrendered.
idiomatic: On wuzi the Jiangnan bandits Xu Kejin, Zhu Yuan, and others surrendered.

literal: Fifth month, day renchen: the Emperor returned to the palace.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renchen, the Emperor returned to the palace.

literal: Day jiawu: visited the Western Park and granted a banquet to the ministers.
idiomatic: On jiawu the Emperor visited the Western Park and granted a banquet to the ministers.

literal: Day gengzi: made Hutu a Deliberative Minister.
idiomatic: On gengzi Hutu was made a Deliberative Minister.

literal: Day jiachen: remitted last year's disaster levies for Pingliang Guard.
idiomatic: On jiachen last year's disaster levies for Pingliang Guard were remitted.

literal: Day bingwu: recalled Dang Chongya as Grand Secretary of the Guoshi Academy and made Gong Dingzi Left Censor-in-Chief.
idiomatic: On bingwu Dang Chongya was recalled as Grand Secretary of the Guoshi Academy and Gong Dingzi was made Left Censor-in-Chief.

literal: Day dingwei: sent officials to review prisoners in all provinces.
idiomatic: On dingwei officials were sent to review prisoners in all provinces.

literal: Day gengxu: remitted last year's disaster levies for prefectures and counties including Xing'an, Hanyin, and Pingli.
idiomatic: On gengxu last year's disaster levies were remitted for prefectures and counties including Xing'an, Hanyin, and Pingli.

literal: Day xinhai: Venus appeared in daylight.
idiomatic: On xinhai Venus appeared in daylight.
